nodes.summary: Let $H_n = \sum_{k=1}^{n} 1/k$ be the $n$-th harmonic number and $\gamma$ the Euler–Mascheroni constant. For every real $x \ge 2$, with $\lfloor x \rfloor$ the floor of $x$, $|H_{\lfloor x \rfloor} - \log x - \gamma| \le 2/x$.
nodes.title: Explicit harmonic error bound at real arguments

nodes.summary: Let $H_n = \sum_{k=1}^{n} 1/k$ be the $n$-th harmonic number and $\gamma$ the Euler–Mascheroni constant. For every natural number $n \ge 1$, $|H_n - \log n - \gamma| \le 1/n$.
nodes.title: Explicit harmonic error bound at integers

nodes.summary: Let $H_k$ denote the $k$-th harmonic number, $\lfloor x \rfloor$ the floor of a real number $x$, and $\gamma$ the Euler–Mascheroni constant. Then $H_{\lfloor x \rfloor} - \log x - \gamma = O(1/x)$ as $x \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Harmonic numbers at the floor track the logarithm

nodes.summary: For every real $x \ge 1$, the floor $\lfloor x \rfloor$ of $x$ satisfies $\log x - \log \lfloor x \rfloor \le 1/\lfloor x \rfloor$.
nodes.title: Logarithm gap between a real number and its floor

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
